title: Extremal secant size distributions in projective planes
summary: Given a point set $S$ in a projective plane of order $q$, each line $\ell$ determines a secant of size $|S\cap \ell|$. We study how concentrated this secant-size distribution can be. We develop a general framework for estimating and, in several cases, determining the extremal number. We point out how the extremal constructions vary depending on the remainder of the size of the set modulo $q$, and classify several extremal families of point sets, building from concurrent lines, Baer {subplanes} and lines in general position.
